messages:
elaine - PM: Quick sync — CS escalated: a large customer needs strict per-region data residency plus a tenant-level SLA. They want a proposal with scope, launch criteria, and cost implications by EOW. @armando @priya can you sketch feasibility?

armando - Eng: We can support per-region residency, but it requires routing templates + tenant slices. Rough ballpark: 3 sprints for a pilot path (routing + metadata plumbing) + 1 sprint for canary/telemetry. Main dev work: routing policy DSL, tenant affinity, and a fallback lane.

priya - Arch: Agree. Key architecture notes:
- We need a routing decision layer that can do region pins, plus affinity windows for sticky KV caches.
- Cross-region KV cache invalidation is the trickiest risk for correctness and cost.
- Also consider quota/ejection policy when capacity is constrained (evict to fallback model or region).

matt - SRE: Operational constraints: 
- SLAs require reserved capacity or Dedicated pools; hosted without commitments can’t guarantee >99.9.
- We need an evacuation playbook if a region loses capacity (auto-fail to fallback lane).
- Observability: token-level metering by tenant+region.

elaine - PM: Customer says they'd pay for Dedicated but wants an initial hosted pilot to feel it out. Proposal: pilot using a small Dedicated slice + hosted fallback. If pilot passes, scale to Dedicated commit. We need acceptance criteria.

armando - Eng: Draft acceptance criteria snippet:```
AC-1: Requests with region pinning are routed to the pinned region >99% of the time.
AC-2: When pinned region is healthy, within-region p95 latency <= 150ms (text gen baseline).
AC-3: Fallback behavior tested: on region drain, requests route to fallback with explicit audit log and no unhandled errors.
AC-4: Billing for residency (per-region surcharge + reserved capacity metering) is validated end-to-end.
AC-5: Canary: 5% traffic for 2 days with telemetry checks (error rate, latency, cost delta).
```

priya - Arch: Add gating for correctness: unit tests + integration scenarios for KV cache consistency across slices. Also require a migration plan for customers who later change pinned region (data residency window).

matt - SRE: Runbook items to add: evacuation checklist, step to toggle fallback lane, metrics dashboards + alerts (p95, 5xx, queue depth by tenant/region). Ops automation for capacity bump must be exercised in pilot.

ops-bot: note: billing team notified — invoice schema will need region labels and reserved capacity line items.

elaine - PM: Decision draft: pilot Q3 (target kickoff in 3 weeks). Owners: Armando (engineering lead), Priya (architecture + gating), Matt (SRE/runbooks), Elaine (product & customer liaison). Deliverables by end of pilot: spec, canary runbook, telemetry dashboard, billing mapping, and customer-facing runbook.

armando - Eng: +1 on timeline. Need a small infra spike to validate routing DSL changes; will schedule this week.

priya - Arch: I'll write the migration/misalignment doc and a compatibility matrix for fallback models.

matt - SRE: I'll prepare the canary dashboard and a synthetic traffic harness for the 5% test.

elaine - PM: I'll draft the spec doc and send to the customer for alignment. Action items and owners in a Google doc — I'll share link later. :thumbsup:

armando - Eng: one open question — pricing model for residency surcharge: fixed per-region reserve vs usage-based delta. We should present both.

elaine - PM: Good point. Priya/matt, include cost sensitivity tests in the canary so CS has data to pick model.

priya - Arch: noted. Also adding a low-cost degraded mode: if dedicated capacity exhausted, degrade to a quantized model variant to preserve availability, and surface quality metrics.

matt - SRE: ack. That gives us three fallback tiers: same-region Dedicated, cross-region fallback, and degraded-model fallback. We'll test all three in canary.

elaine - PM: Thanks team. I'll compile these notes into the spec and post the doc by EOD. If anyone needs to change scope, flag here before I share with CS. :spiral_calendar:

armando - Eng: sounds good.

priya - Arch: lgtm.

matt - SRE: lgtm.
